name: [⛽] Hell's Garden [BETA]
desc:
🥕 Welcome to Hell's Garden! 🥕

 Step into a dangerous farm where you can:
🌳 Plant and grow your own garden
🗺️ Explore mysterious lands
🏗️ Build and expand your base
⚔️ Fight terrifying monsters

In this game you can play with multiple classes and level them up!

💰 Everything can be earned through gameplay no paywalls!

🧪 The game is still evolving — your feedback helps shape future updates!

🎁 Use codes Alpha and ezspins for free rewards!


✨ Inspired by Grow a Garden,Dead Rails and by 99 nights in the forest
